text:
Before opening, handover calls stood out in your thoughts, and we are sorry to learn that your companion animal travel experience with Aurelia Skyways left you feeling unheard, unsettled, and inadequately supported. You wrote to us because the handling of your booking, the communication around your pet's care, and the pickup process did not meet the standard that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is expected to provide.

Please accept our sincere apology for the distress this caused. Our desk is meant to welcome questions in a warm professional tone and to coordinate care from booking through pickup with steady attention. When that chain is broken, the impact on both traveler and animal is immediate, and we understand that this is not a minor concern. The senior coordinator has been informed and is reviewing the service path that should have protected your peace of mind at every step.

We are treating your complaint as urgent. The matter now sits with the team that oversees daily service decisions, and we are checking the record of contact, the handling notes, and the handover between staff members so that responsibility is clear. Where communication fell short, we will address it directly. Where process was delayed or uncertain, we will correct it. Where reassurance should have been given, it should have been given without hesitation.

Our priority is to restore trust and to make sure your companion animal is supported with care, dignity, and calm handling. We will also reinforce expectations within the desk so that travelers receive timely guidance, clear updates, and respectful follow-through from the first inquiry to the final pickup. If you continue to travel with Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will remain ready to assist with closer oversight and a more careful service path.

We regret that you had to raise this complaint at all, and we are committed to resolving it properly. Your experience matters, and it will not be set aside. Companion Animal Travel Desk
